reviews.Title: Nice product
reviews.Comment: It's a good budget Bluetooth headset. But you have to be really careful with the wires. I have on many occasions accidentally yanked on the wires and damaged them. Don't know how much longer headset will last. I like how you can connect two devices at once. Sounds quality is good. Phone call quality is also good. If you can afford to I would recommend to pay a little bit more for a sturdier Boult headset.
